what_happened: Scene layout/style 8: steel single sink with drainboard; gooseneck spout with a round head and a white paddle lever on top of the base (same faucet as s4, s8, s10, s22). Stage 0: the gripper reached the paddle at ~152 (touch 157-205, 210-212), partly closed at 157 (0.043) and 209 (0.028), and rotated the paddle 200-224 (handle 0.02 -> 0.23 rad). At ~224-236 it pulled away; the wrist view at 236 shows the paddle left pointing down at about half its travel. Handle stayed 0.23 (needs > 0.40; successes go to 0.50). 300 the arm moved right, then 371-429 it pushed the spout head right to +0.83 with the water off, as if doing stage 1. 456 the gripper closed (0.014) and from ~560 to 900 it hovered right of the faucet at a standoff with the closed gripper, the faucet in the wrist view, touching only at 601 and 810-824. Water never ran.
causal_chain: paddle turned only 0.23 rad (200-224) and released -> no water -> spout swung right with water off 371-429 (no credit) -> hovered 560-900 -> stage 0 never complete
self_recovery: none: it never went back to the paddle after 236.
official_criterion_notes: Criterion agrees with the video (no water stream).
